en.topic_title: China curbs drug precursor exports ahead of Xi’s US visit

zh.topic_title: China curbs drug precursor exports ahead of Xi’s US visit

en.topic_title: China curbs drug precursor exports ahead of Xi’s US visit
en.topic_summary:
China unveiled export restrictions on precursor chemicals that can be used to make drugs on Tuesday, days before a high-stakes meeting between President Xi Jinping and US counterpart Donald Trump.



Fentanyl. Photo: US Drug Enforcement Administration.



The rules, announced in a statement by Beijing’s commerce ministry, take effect immediately.



They apply to two varieties of substances which will now be subject to applications in order to be exported to the United States, Mexico or Ca
